{
  "title": "Our understanding of the College's needs",
  "text": "Each bidder submits its proposal through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of at most 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC [REQ-0002]. The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment [REQ-0014]. The Supplier keeps an audit record of every signature event, including the signer's identity, the time, and the document version [REQ-0003], and supports signing on current desktop and mobile browsers [REQ-0004]. Reminders are sent to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours [REQ-0005], and signed documents are stored for ten years [REQ-0007]. The service must integrate with the College's student records system through its existing REST API [REQ-0009], and shall be available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance [REQ-0011]. Additionally, the Supplier should provide templates for the College's twelve most used forms [REQ-0006], migrate the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28 [REQ-0008], and respond to severity-one incidents within one hour, at any time of day [REQ-0012]. Bidders may propose an on-premises deployment option [REQ-0010].",
